rv.q: 'Queen of Hearts' feels like 'Moulin Rouge!' for actual bohemians.
'Queen of Hearts' is the best date-night show in New York City right now.
McCormick and his company have tapped into the contradictions of Carroll's masterpiece in an experience that extends beyond the fourth wall and five senses.
Queen of Hearts is an adventure for the senses in a captivating world of erotic imagination.

“An imaginative, visually stunning, musical send-up of the children’s classic...Overlong...and not all of the numbers impress equally; but the sheer ability of the performers...is often nothing short of astonishing...’Queen of Hearts’ invokes the source material while using virtually none of its language...
The lyrics connect to Carroll's story thematically, though sometimes obliquely, with a word or a sentiment.
